10 استرهبهُ He called forth fear of him, so that men feared him. (TA.) وَٱسْتَرْهَبُوهُمْ, in the Kur [vii. 113], has been expl. as meaning And they called forth fear of them, [i. e. of themselves,] so that men feared them. (TA.) ―
-b2- See also 4.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
